blocks.text: Let's look at this one. Select all the numbers that are solutions of negative seven is less than one minus two x, which is less than or equal to five.
blocks.display: Select all the numbers that are solutions of −7 < 1 − 2x ≤ 5.

blocks.text: Negative two. Yes: one minus two times negative two is five, and negative seven is less than five, which is less than or equal to five.
Zero. Yes: one minus two times zero is one, which is between negative seven and five.
Three. Yes: one minus two times three is negative five, which is between negative seven and five.
Four. No: one minus two times four is negative seven, which is not greater than negative seven.
Negative three. No: one minus two times negative three is seven, which is more than five.
Negative two, zero and three are solutions: the solutions are negative two less than or equal to x, less than four. Dividing by negative two flips both symbols.
